items.followUp: Which tag is used to define the body section of an HTML document?

rubric.why: Identifies the opening tag for the head section.
rubric.how: Award for the correct opening tag.

rubric.why: Identifies the closing tag that ends the head section.
rubric.how: Award for the correct closing tag.

modelAnswer: The head section is enclosed in the <head> and </head> tags.

rubric.why: States the defining feature of softlifting: copying software without authorization.
rubric.description: Defines softlifting as unauthorized or illegal copying of software.
rubric.how: Award for identifying unauthorized software copying.

rubric.why: Gives the common example that distinguishes softlifting.
rubric.description: Mentions using one licensed copy on multiple computers without permission.
rubric.how: Award for the multiple-computer example or an equivalent explanation.

modelAnswer: Softlifting is the unauthorized copying or installation of software.
For example, installing one licensed copy of a program on several computers without permission.
